aliases: 3+3MP WizColor Hybrid-zoom PT 4G Solar Power Network Camera

power.method: Built-in 65 Wh lithium battery + 8 W solar panel, USB-C (QC2.0) charging

features: 3+3MP dual-lens: fixed wide lens + hybrid-zoom (3.6-8.4 mm) PT lens
WizColor warm-light color night vision (fixed 30 m / PT 50 m)
PT lens electric pan 0-350, tilt 0-90; 360 view without blind spots
smart tracking (auto-tracking lite + linkage tracking), SMD 3.0
active deterrence: white-light warning + 3 configurable sound alarms
wire-free 65 Wh battery + 8 W solar, AOV ultra-low-power mode
release_notes: The Dahua APOLLO BP6X-4G (IPC-PTS2649C-3E3Z-4GB20) is a wire-free battery and solar 4G dual-lens pan & tilt camera pairing a fixed 3MP wide lens with a 3MP hybrid-zoom PT lens, WizColor color night vision, smart auto-tracking and light-and-sound active deterrence. Verified against the official Dahua datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: APOLLO BP6X-4G: app-only via DMSS (4G/battery). No official ONVIF/RTSP; use the DMSS cloud app, or Generic Camera (RTSP) only if a local stream is later exposed.

blue_iris.notes: No confirmed local RTSP path; DMSS-managed 4G/battery camera.
